testo:
■ While you are summoning this creature, you may reveal any number of cards that cost 9 in your hand. For each card you reveal, this creature costs 1 less to summon. It can't cost 0 or less.
■ Evolution: Put on one of your light creatures.
Blocker Double Breaker

■ 進化：光のクリーチャー1体の上に置く。
